title: Implement GET /api/batches/[id]/prospects route (status polling)
description: Create the API route for polling all prospect statuses in a batch. Used by the generation trigger UI for real-time progress updates.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/batches/[id]/prospects returns all prospects for the batch
Response includes: id, slug, business_name, status, error_message
Fast enough for 3-second polling (< 200ms response time)

steps.details: Export GET handler. Check batch exists. Call `getProspectsByBatch(id)` — return id, slug, business_name, status, error_message fields only (not full page_data which is large). Return JSON array.
GET /api/batches/[id]/prospects. Verify response is fast and includes all prospect status fields but NOT page_data.
